name: GPTQModel: LLM quantization toolkit (GitHub: ModelCloud/GPTQModel)
notes: GPTQModel GitHub repository. Extensible platform for LLM quantization with HW acceleration for NVIDIA, AMD, Intel GPU and CPU. Supports GPTQ, AWQ, ParoQuant, GGUF, FP8, EXL3, QQQ. References Marlin, Swordfish, and Machete kernels. Includes device-aware kernel selection and hardened Machete runtime caching.
